_comment: Test scenario for LAMBDA: images from the source "EO optical (fictional)" (the Syria convoy demo, with locations) in a layer named "Satellite", drawn from their own location.point. recent_days, limit and layer are read by hl/items.py and not sent to HL API; APP_ITEMS_PER_TYPE overrides limit. No location entities exist on LAMBDA, so the Location layer stays empty. all_fields: every populated i360 item field is shown (table without media fields, viewer with everything). A second query reads items whose source_application is ADINT (any item type) into a layer named "ADINT", showing only the id and location fields (fields: [item_id, location]). entity_mapping: the Entity layer shows every visible i360 PERSON_OF_INTEREST with the person viewer.

entity_mapping._comment: Every visible i360 PERSON_OF_INTEREST, shown with the app's person viewer. Paths accept the record nested under entity, at the top, or under sections. image_file_id, telecom_imei and telecom_msisdn are turned into image_url and telecom by hl/items.py.

fields.canonical_name: entity_name | entity.details.full_name | details.full_name | sections.details.full_name | entity.general.entity_name | general.entity_name | sections.general.entity_name

investigation_links._comment: Saving a person to an investigation's memory creates this i360 LINK (HL API create_link).
